metadata.title: Harden monitor-codebase: code searchability, fix dispatch, trend tracking
metadata.description: Fix missing, broken, and aspirational features in monitor-codebase. Three tracks: (A) code searchability via treesitter + embedding, (B) fix dispatch via orchestrate + code-runner replacing broken subagent path, (C) trend tracking across nightly runs.

capability_overlap.memory_recall:
Searched "monitor-codebase code search treesitter embedding" — found:
- ingest-code already has Phase 3 for treesitter (not wired into rescan)
- treesitter scan command exists and works
- embedding service running on port 8602
- Embedding-at-insert contract: memory learn embeds automatically
capability_overlap.create_justification: Only trend_tracker.py is new code. All other tasks extend or wire existing skills.

lanes.label: Cleanup dead references and update docs

tasks.title: Enhance ingest-code rescan to extract symbols via treesitter
tasks.prompt:
Enhance ingest_code.py rescan command to call the treesitter skill's scan
subcommand on each configured directory. Add a --treesitter flag that:
1. Invokes the treesitter skill scan on each configured dir
2. Extracts function signatures, class hierarchies, imports
3. Stores each symbol to memory with tags:
   ["codebase", "symbol", "function|class|method", "<name>", "<file_stem>"]
4. Uses memory daemon Unix socket at /run/user/1000/embry/memory.sock

The treesitter skill entry point is at:
.pi/skills/treesitter/run.sh symbols <file>
.pi/skills/treesitter/run.sh scan <directory>

tasks.title: Add --verify-embeddings flag to ingest-code rescan
tasks.prompt:
Add a --verify-embeddings flag to ingest_code.py rescan that spot-checks
10 random stored items to confirm they have embeddings. Uses memory recall
with the function name — should return the function entry.

Memory daemon: Unix socket at /run/user/1000/embry/memory.sock
Endpoint: POST with {"q": "function_name", "k": 1} to the recall path

tasks.title: Update monitor-codebase Step 6 to use --treesitter flag
tasks.prompt:
Update the monitor-codebase shell script Step 6 to pass --treesitter flag
to ingest-code rescan. Remove --no-validate so CWE scanning runs too.

Current ingest_args line:
  ingest_args=(rescan --since "$since" --no-validate --scope "monitor-$project_name")

Change to:
  ingest_args=(rescan --since "$since" --treesitter --scope "monitor-$project_name")

tasks.title: Replace Step 10 broken subagent dispatch with orchestrate code-runner
tasks.prompt:
Replace Step 10 in the monitor-codebase shell script. The current dispatch
uses agent-inbox and subagent-service which has 0% file write success.

Replace with:
1. Safety git commit (revert point)
2. Call generate_fix_plan.py from skills-ci to generate YAML from violations
3. Call the orchestrate skill entry point to execute the fix plan
4. Commit any fixes made

The generate_fix_plan.py is at:
.pi/skills/skills-ci/generate_fix_plan.py

The orchestrate skill entry point is at:
.pi/skills/orchestrate/run.sh

Keep --fix as the gate (scan-only mode must never trigger this step).

tasks.title: Add trend comparison step: diff current report vs previous
tasks.prompt:
After Step 9 (aggregate report) in the monitor-codebase shell script,
add a trend comparison step.

1. Find previous report for this project:
   prev=$(ls -t "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/${project_name}_2*.json" | sed -n '2p')

2. If previous exists, compute delta via inline python:
   Print REGRESSION (+N issues), IMPROVED (-N issues), or STABLE.

3. Store delta in a shell variable for the notification step.

Add between Step 9 and Step 10.

tasks.title: Create trend_tracker.py to store trend data to memory
tasks.prompt:
Create a new file trend_tracker.py in the monitor-codebase skill directory.
This file stores trend data to memory via httpx.

Uses httpx to Unix socket /run/user/1000/embry/memory.sock.
Endpoint: POST to the learn path.
Payload: problem="monitor-codebase trend: {project} {date}",
  solution=JSON with project, date, total_issues, delta, breakdown.
  scope="codebase_trends", tags=["trend", "project:{name}"]

Also update the shell script to call this after trend comparison:
  python3 "$SKILL_DIR/trend_tracker.py" "$project_name" "$report_file" "$prev"

tasks.title: Remove dead composes and update SKILL.md pipeline table
tasks.prompt:
Update the monitor-codebase SKILL.md:
1. Remove battle, create-code, agent-inbox from composes list. Add orchestrate.
2. Update the pipeline table:
   - Step 6 now includes --treesitter flag for symbol extraction
   - New Step 9.5: trend comparison (REGRESSION/IMPROVED/STABLE)
   - Step 10 uses orchestrate + code-runner (not subagent-service)
3. Remove all references to subagent-service dispatch flow.
